sections.title: How We Run It: 5-Stage Operation
paragraphs: When your executives, visitors and staff depend on getting somewhere on time every day, transportation becomes an operation in its own right.
AB runs it for you: we plan the routes and vehicle mix, supply vetted chauffeurs and drivers, monitor every trip from our Riyadh control room, and report on what happened.

bullets.text: 1. Requirements review: Passenger groups, locations, hours, and service levels.
2. Programme design: Routes, vehicle classes, driver numbers, and standby cover.
3. Mobilisation: Vehicles prepared, drivers briefed on your sites and protocol.
4. Daily operation: Live tracking, dispatch changes and incident handling 24/7.
5. Monthly review: Usage, punctuality and cost by department.

sections.title: Standards Written into Every Programme
paragraphs: Our service commitments are contractually codified into measurable SLAs. Every AB agreement guarantees four foundational standards.
Commercial terms, rate cards, and consolidated billing are set out on Corporate Accounts.

bullets.text: Chauffeurs licensed, background-checked and trained to the AB Chauffeur Standard.
Vehicles GPS-tracked, strictly late-model (< 36 months), cleaned and inspected daily.
Standby vehicles and relief drivers ready for each programme.
Incident reporting to your nominated contact within 15 minutes of an event.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a dedicated driver and on-demand chauffeurs?
faqs.a: A dedicated driver and vehicle are assigned to you full-time for an agreed period. On-demand chauffeurs are booked per trip or per hour from AB's pool.

faqs.q: Who employs the drivers on a dedicated contract?
faqs.a: AB does. We handle vetting, payroll, relief cover and regulatory compliance under our local operating licences.

faqs.q: Can routes change as our headcount changes?
faqs.a: Yes. Routes are reviewed monthly, or sooner on request as staff numbers or office locations shift.

faqs.q: Do you cover more than one country under one contract?
faqs.a: Yes, through licensed AB entities in Saudi Arabia (KSA), the UAE and Qatar, all governed under a single master framework agreement.

faqs.q: How are incidents handled?
faqs.a: The Riyadh control room manages incidents live 24/7, dispatches standby relief vehicles immediately, and sends a written report to your nominated contact within 15 minutes.

sections.title: How We Plan Your Event
paragraphs: Guests remember the first hour and the last hour of an event, and both usually happen in a vehicle. AB plans and runs every movement around your event: airport arrivals, hotel shuttles, VIP cars, speaker and artist transfers, staff transport and the departure wave.
Everything is coordinated from one control room, with our team on site.

bullets.text: 1. Brief call: Dates, venues, guest profile, numbers, and non-negotiables.
2. Draft plan and quote: Vehicle schedule, staffing, and price within agreed working days.
3. Site visits: Venues, hotels and airport routes walked and timed.
4. Rehearsal day: Drivers briefed and routes driven before guests arrive.
5. Live operation: Control room and on-site coordinators run the plan.
6. Debrief: Detailed post-event report and lessons learned.

sections.title: What We Deliver: Flawless Movement
paragraphs: The success of an event hinges on how smoothly guests arrive, move, and depart. AB turns transport into an invisible, friction-free operation.
From the first airport pickup to the final shuttle wave of the evening, every movement is orchestrated by our command team.

bullets.text: Written transport plan covering loading zones, routes, timings and standby fleet.
Airport meet-and-greet desks with real-time flight tracking for every guest.
Timed shuttle loops between official hotels and venues with live frequency adjustments.
Dedicated VIP chauffeur pools for keynote speakers, dignitaries, and artists.
On-site transport coordinators liaising with security and venue management.
Post-event report with passenger throughput, vehicle utilisation, and on-time stats.

faqs.q: How far in advance should we contact you?
faqs.a: For major conferences and large-scale gatherings over 500 delegates, we recommend initiating planning 8–12 weeks ahead to secure optimal fleet allocations and coordinate venue permits. Smaller VIP pools and board offsites can be mobilised on accelerated timelines where fleet capacity permits.

faqs.q: Can you work with our venue's security and accreditation process?
faqs.a: Yes. Our on-site transport coordinators liaise directly with venue management, local authorities, and private security details to handle vehicle access passes, security manifests, secure loading bays, and VIP drop-off protocols.

faqs.q: What happens if a flight is delayed or a session overruns?
faqs.a: Our centralized event control room tracks incoming flights live and monitors venue agendas in real time. We automatically adjust chauffeur dispatch schedules and maintain dedicated standby vehicles to absorb unexpected delays without guest disruption.

faqs.q: Do you provide branded vehicles or signage?
faqs.a: Yes. Upon request, we provide discrete co-branded vehicle decals, digital airport meet-and-greet signage, branded vehicle headrest covers, and uniformed dispatch staff aligned with your event brand identity.

faqs.q: Can you supply buses and VIP cars under one contract?
faqs.a: Yes. We consolidate luxury sedans, VIP MPVs, crew vans, and 50-passenger executive motorcoaches under a single master movement plan, one dedicated on-site command structure, and a unified commercial invoice.

faqs.q: Do you provide transport reports for sponsors or authorities?
faqs.a: Yes. Following the event, our control room provides comprehensive data reports detailing passenger throughput, peak-hour movements, vehicle utilisation, on-time performance against plan, and safety audits.

content.heading: How we plan your event
content.description: Transport failure is not an option when thousands of delegates and high-profile guests rely on your schedule. Our 6-stage lifecycle eliminates uncertainty weeks before the first guest touches down.

items.heading: 1. Brief Call
items.description: Dates, venues, guest profile, expected numbers, and your operational non-negotiables established with an event transport director.

items.heading: 2. Draft Plan & Quote
items.description: Comprehensive vehicle schedule, on-site staffing allocation, loading plans and transparent pricing within agreed working days.

items.heading: 3. Site Visits & Reconnaissance
items.description: Venues, partner hotels, security checkpoints, loading bays, and airport terminal routes walked and precisely timed.

items.heading: 4. Rehearsal & Dry Run
items.description: Drivers briefed on security protocols, vehicle passes checked, staging areas tested, and routes driven before guests arrive.

items.heading: 5. Live Operation
items.description: Dedicated control room and on-site coordinators actively orchestrate every wave with GPS telematics and live flight tracking.

items.heading: 6. Post-Event Debrief & Report
items.description: Complete audit report covering passenger volumes, trip counts by vehicle type, on-time performance against plan, and lessons learned.

content.heading: Vehicles deployed across every tier
content.description: We deploy anything from a curated pool of VIP cars for a board offsite to multi-tier vehicle fleets moving thousands of passengers over multi-day public events.

content.heading: Event types we power
content.description: Tailored mobility architecture designed for the specific operational demands of regional gatherings.

items.title: Festivals & Concerts
items.description: Staged guest ingress and egress routing, artist green-room transfers, and dedicated production crew shuttles.

items.title: Sports Tournaments
items.description: Athlete and team transfers, referee delegations, VIP lounges, media contingents, and stadium access management.

items.title: Product Launches & Gala Dinners
items.description: Punctual, elegant arrival coordination with white-glove chauffeur standards for corporate celebrations and brand showcases.

items.title: Weddings & Private Celebrations
items.description: Bespoke guest shuttles, bridal party luxury sedans, and coordinated venue arrivals for high-end weddings and private celebrations.

content.heading: Proven Event Transport Across Saudi Arabia, UAE & Qatar
content.description: Managing guest logistics across major Gulf cities requires deep familiarity with local venue geometries, permit processes, and municipal traffic regulations. AB maintains registered operating entities, staging yards, and experienced dispatch teams across Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Doha.

content.heading: Send your event brief or RFP
content.description: Submit your event parameters or speak directly with an event logistics director. We design custom vehicle schedules, loading protocols, and on-site command setups across Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Qatar.
content.successMessage: Thank you. Our senior event logistics team will review your requirements and contact you within 4 business hours with an initial movement framework.

content.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
content.description: Direct operational answers for conference producers, agency directors, and event procurement teams.

items.question: How far in advance should we contact you?
items.answer: For major conferences and large-scale gatherings over 500 delegates, we recommend initiating planning 8–12 weeks ahead to secure optimal fleet allocations and coordinate venue permits. Smaller VIP pools and board offsites can be mobilised on accelerated timelines where fleet capacity permits.

items.question: Can you work with our venue's security and accreditation process?
items.answer: Yes. Our on-site transport coordinators liaise directly with venue management, local authorities, and private security details to handle vehicle access passes, security manifests, secure loading bays, and VIP drop-off protocols.

items.question: What happens if a flight is delayed or a session overruns?
items.answer: Our centralized event control room tracks incoming flights live and monitors venue agendas in real time. We automatically adjust chauffeur dispatch schedules and maintain dedicated standby vehicles to absorb unexpected delays without guest disruption.

items.question: Do you provide branded vehicles or signage?
items.answer: Yes. Upon request, we provide discrete co-branded vehicle decals, digital airport meet-and-greet signage, branded vehicle headrest covers, and uniformed dispatch staff aligned with your event brand identity.

items.question: Can you supply buses and VIP cars under one contract?
items.answer: Yes. We consolidate luxury sedans, VIP MPVs, crew vans, and 50-passenger executive motorcoaches under a single master movement plan, one dedicated on-site command structure, and a unified commercial invoice.

items.question: Do you provide transport reports for sponsors or authorities?
items.answer: Yes. Following the event, our control room provides comprehensive data reports detailing passenger throughput, peak-hour movements, vehicle utilisation, on-time performance against plan, and safety audits.

content.heading: Event transportation, planned like an operation.
content.description: Guests remember the first hour and the last hour of an event. Coordinate your arrivals, venue shuttles, VIP pools and departure waves with our dedicated event control room.

content.heading: Powering Regional
content.description:
As the Kingdom and GCC region undergo unprecedented economic diversification under the Vision 2030 mandate, executive mobility infrastructure has evolved exponentially. AB operates at the nexus of this transformation, providing highly secure, scalable, and meticulously managed mobility solutions for multinational corporations entering the market.

Our strategic dispatch capabilities are engineered specifically for premier economic corridors. We maintain a continuous, vetted presence within the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD) and the Diplomatic Quarter (DQ), navigating rigorous security protocols with absolute discretion and efficiency.

Beyond standard transfers, our Intercity Transfers services provide global executives with the fluid, reliable mobility required to execute complex operations across the GCC's expanding urban and industrial footprint.

content.heading: Enterprise Procurement for Intercity Transfers.
content.description: Connect with our enterprise procurement team for dedicated account management, centralized billing, and priority fleet access.
content.successMessage: An enterprise account manager will contact you within 24 hours.

content.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
content.description: Key answers regarding our Intercity Transfers operations, billing frameworks, and procurement standards.

items.question: How do I book and set up a corporate account for Intercity Transfers?
items.answer: You can initiate booking immediately through our digital portal or contact our enterprise desk. For recurring requirements, corporate accounts provide SLA guarantees, consolidated monthly billing, and priority fleet dispatch.

items.question: What are your Duty of Care and vetting standards?
items.answer: All AB chauffeurs undergo comprehensive background checks, hold valid defensive driving certifications, and sign legally binding NDAs. Our vehicles are subject to rigorous preventative maintenance and 24/7 ITS telemetry monitoring.

items.question: Can you support multi-city operations across Saudi Arabia and the GCC?
items.answer: Yes. Our Transport Control Room manages cross-border and inter-city itineraries across Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Doha, and Muscat with seamless continuity.

items.question: How does corporate billing and SAP Concur integration work?
items.answer: Upon account activation, corporate rides can be automatically routed into SAP Concur or your corporate expense system with itemized VAT receipts and designated cost-center allocations.
